description: The numeric controls as they are in the game: every slider now carries a number box beside it. One parking design (set a value through the panel, undo it, build) and the flower pattern editor (its size/rotation/width/offset sliders). The ui shots are the real screen, so the panel and the boxes can be read.

scenarios.note: Bucket, parking compact, a ui shot of the Design panel, aisleWidth set to 7 through the panel, undo, build. Read the ui shots: the number box shows the value, the m unit and the lock/reset icons without overlapping the slider.

A 60x50 m flower plot, one ring pattern added, a ui shot of the pattern editor (size, rotation, ribbon width, east/west and north/south are sliders with a number box now), then the pattern scaled by its green handle so the editor still drives the tool.
